title: EmailComparator non_exhaustive with no constructor
description: EmailComparator is #[non_exhaustive] but has no new() or builder. External crates (including jmap-mail-client) cannot construct EmailComparator values at all — struct literal syntax is forbidden by #[non_exhaustive] from outside the defining crate, and no constructor method exists. Email/query sort orders become impossible to build programmatically. Fix: add EmailComparator::new(property: ComparatorProperty) -> Self.
